caption: Figure 8.1: Particle-beam excitation with wakis.sources.Beam: direct vs. TF/SF injection. Across top: a rigid Gaussian bunch of charge q, RMS length σ_z, transverse offset (x_s, y_s), and velocity v = βc moving along +z. Left: source_type='direct' deposits J_z along the beam line inside metallic beam pipes. Right: source_type='tfsf' precomputes the exact 2D transverse TEM self-field (E_⊥^beam, H_⊥^beam) on the entrance/exit pipe cross-section and injects it on the boundary planes so the bunch enters without artificial transition radiation.

Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: primary grid G and its quantities in blue, dual grid G-tilde and its quantities in orange, exact/topological items in dark grey, approximate/material items in green, failure or warning items in red. Colourblind-safe. Every label must be spelled exactly as listed in this brief; mathematical symbols must be typeset correctly (hats, tildes, subscripts, transposes). Do not add any number, value, equation, software name, product name, logo, watermark or title that is not listed in this brief. Prefer fewer, larger labels over many small ones. No 3D photorealism, no cartoon characters, no hand-drawn or xkcd style.

Two panels side by side beneath a shared top banner displaying the Gaussian beam current density from line 1502: 'J_z(x, y, z, t) = (q v / (√(2π) σ_z)) δ_h(x − x_s) δ_h(y − y_s) exp(−(z − z₀ − vt)² / (2σ_z²))'. LEFT PANEL (blue border, heading '1. Direct injection: source_type="direct" (default)'): a longitudinal cavity cross-section with metallic entrance and exit beam pipes ('bc_low=[..., "pec"] or "cpml"'). Along the axis (x_s, y_s), draw a blue Gaussian bunch ellipse moving right with arrow 'v = βc,  q, σ_z' depositing current 'J_z' directly on the grid edges. At the entrance plane, draw small red wavefront ripples labelled 'artificial transition radiation if injected at a bare boundary'. RIGHT PANEL (green border, heading '2. TF/SF beam injection: source_type="tfsf"'): the same cavity and beam pipes, with two vertical green Huygens planes at the entrance and exit pipe cross-sections.
